title: Moon Hub AUTO FARM AUTO CHALLENGE AUTO DUNGEON AND MORE
features:
[ NEW ] Auto Farm
        └─ Select map and enemy to farm automatically
        └─ Teleports to mob, attacks until death, repeats
        └─ Handles mob respawns and new mobs appearing

[ NEW ] Auto Raid
        └─ Select map and difficulty, enters and clears raids automatically
        └─ Auto Open Chest with selectable chest types (Special, Dungeon Key, Normal)
        └─ Detects if already in a raid on enable and resumes from there
        └─ Restarts automatically if kicked or raid folder disappears

[ NEW ] Auto Tower
        └─ Creates and clears tower automatically
        └─ Detects active tower on enable and continues from there

[ NEW ] Auto Awakening Dungeon
        └─ Enters Double Dungeons on Nightmare and clears all mobs
        └─ Auto Open Chest with selectable types (Dungeon Key, Normal)
        └─ Restarts automatically if kicked mid-dungeon

[ NEW ] Auto Roll Talents
        └─ Multi-unit selection with rotation
        └─ Multi-talent selection (Damage, Ability Damage, Critical, Speed)
        └─ Target rarity dropdown (D through SSS)
        └─ Live talent status display per unit
        └─ Notifies when target is reached

[ NEW ] Auto Roll Trait
        └─ Multi-unit selection with rotation
        └─ Primary and/or Sub Trait slot selection
        └─ Full trait list (Rare → Secret) as stop conditions
        └─ Live trait status display per unit

[ NEW ] Auto Open Summon
        └─ Automatically opens the nearest summoner every 0.08s

[ NEW ] Skip Summon Animations
        └─ Skips summoning animations for faster rolling

[ NEW ] Auto Boss Fight
        └─ Activates automatically on the real-world boss fight schedule
        └─ Pauses Auto Farm, Raid, Tower and Dungeon during the fight
        └─ Returns to original map and position after finishing

[ NEW ] Misc
        └─ Claim All Codes — redeems all promo codes at once
        └─ Auto Claim Achievements — claims all available achievements
        └─ Auto Click — holds click continuously
        └─ Anti AFK — prevents kick from inactivity
        └─ Auto Upgrades — upgrades Attack Ranges, Sprint Speed or Backpack Capacity every 5s
        └─ Auto Spin Alucard Event — spins the Alucard Release Event wheel every 1s
        └─ Hide Notifications — hides in-game notification popups
        └─ Hide Name — hides your overhead name tag
[ NEW ] Exploits
        └─ Dps Exploit (increase your dps 2x,3x)
        └─ Inf Damage (increase your damage how much u want)
        └─ Rollback (with this u can make inf sukuna and roll infinite talents and much more
